q1_issues.issue: "settle" is a distributive predicate over two definite-plural groups, so each group event should be accompanied by a per-member (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) (And (Member (sk_settle $x) settle) (Patient (sk_settle $x) $x) (Past (sk_settle $x)))) rule — the "the dogs barked" case — and neither sk_bodies_1 nor sk_markers_1 has one.

notes: The distributive-by-default split of the coordinated subject, the single shared bottom/cove symbols, Patient for a mass moved by gravity, event-only Location (no LocatedIn on the settled things), and the one-symbol name sunken_cove with its separate kind atom are all right; PartOf for "the bottom of the Sunken Cove" is the relational part-noun genitive rather than the place-in-place LocatedIn rule, which reads as the correct side of that boundary.
